python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im19 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0019.png'))
# Sofa color is [110, 116, 124] or darker
mask = (np.abs(im19[:,:,0].astype(int) - 110) < 40) & (np.abs(im19[:,:,1].astype(int) - 116) < 40) & (np.abs(im19[:,:,2].astype(int) - 124) < 40)
coords = np.argwhere(mask)
coords = [c for c in coords if c[1] > 320 and c[0] > 350]
coords = np.array(coords)

import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame(coords, columns=['v', 'u'])
bottoms = df.groupby('u')['v'].max()
print('obs19 sofa bottom u min:', df['u'].min(), 'max:', df['u'].max())
print('obs19 sofa bottom v min:', bottoms.min(), 'max:', bottoms.max())
print('Corner at u min:', df['u'].min(), bottoms.loc[df['u'].min()])
print('Corner at u max:', df['u'].max(), bottoms.loc[df['u'].max()])
print('Corner at max v:', bottoms.idxmax(), bottoms.max())
"
